BVMBA Tuesday Social Ride

Bryan, TX · Lake Bryan · Mountain bike

No-dropBeginner friendly

BVMBA Tuesday Social Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Bryan, TX. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:30 pm from Lake Bryan boat ramp parking lot. Pace: all skill levels. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: all skill levels. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the BVMBA Tuesday Social Ride group ride

The Bryan–College Station mountain bike club's weekly no-drop trail ride at Lake Bryan. Meet and greet at 6:15, roll at 6:30. All skill levels. Check the BVMBA calendar for changes.
